title: Because: the analyst agent that shows its work

slides.title: Because
slides.subtitle: The analyst agent that shows its work. Ask why a number moved and audit every claim.
slides.notes: GenAI Works Open Agent Hackathon 2026. Live demo https://because-agent.vercel.app. Code https://github.com/OlsOls4/because

slides.title: Why questions get fluent answers that nobody can check.
slides.body: LLMs explain fluently but unverifiably. Dashboards show what changed but not why. Doing it properly takes hours.
slides.notes: Answering 'why did X change?' properly means pulling several sources, aligning periods, testing competing explanations and writing down what does not fit.

slides.title: A 5 pm deadline
slides.body: Her draft blames weak demand for Intel's margin fall. She asks Because instead.
slides.image_prompt: Real screenshot of the live demo on mobile: a tapped citation

items.heading: Ask
items.body: Why did Intel's gross margin fall in 2024?

items.heading: Get
items.body: 40.0% to 32.7%: one-off charges and depreciation lead, lower revenue third

items.heading: Tap
items.body: Taps F15 to see the SEC row and SQL, then rewrites her sentence

slides.notes: Real output: examples/outputs/why-did-intel-s-gross-margin-fall-in-2024.md. Medium 0.65, capped because the largest driver ($6.97B restructuring and impairment, over 2.5x the prior-years average) is likely one-off. Screenshot of https://because-agent.vercel.app on 23 Oct 2026.

slides.title: One investigation
slides.body: Scout guards and signs a contract. Zetaris SQL pulls evidence. Each hypothesis gets a numeric test. H-MEM remembers with provenance.
slides.notes: Scout -> Analyst -> DataHarness (Zetaris over JDBC; DuckDB fallback) -> SEC EDGAR XBRL, ONS, FRED. Premise check, hypotheses with explicit rules, calibrated confidence. Optional NVIDIA NIM narrative is rejected unless every sentence cites a finding and every number appears in the evidence.

slides.title: Live on Zetaris
slides.body: A real Lightning 2.4.3.1 instance on a GitHub runner answers every example question over JDBC.
slides.image_prompt: Real screenshot of the recorded Zetaris runs in the live UI

items.heading: Federated
items.body: EDGAR x FRED and ONS x FRED in one SQL JOIN

slides.notes: https://github.com/OlsOls4/because/actions/runs/39949595787. Traces in examples/zetaris_runs/. USL: docs/zetaris_usl.sql and usl.log. US unemployment has no second source, so no federated JOIN there.

slides.title: Gas leads UK inflation
slides.body: One Lightning JOIN of ONS CPI and FRED European gas prices. Correlation by lead time, 2015-2022, 96 months.
slides.notes: Query Q-49752693a1 on zetaris-jdbc in run 39949595787: ONS D7G7 JOIN FRED PNGASEUUSDM on month, 12-month change in gas price, lag via LAG window. Co-movement, not proof of cause. Companies get EDGAR revenue x FRED semiconductor PPI instead: Intel FY2024 price-adjusted revenue -3.6%.

slides.title: Evaluation
slides.notes: scripts/eval.py, docs/EVAL.md, examples/eval/results.md. DuckDB backend, live public endpoints, no LLM. Brier 0.124. 19 questions is a sanity check, not a benchmark.

slides.title: Where it fails

items.heading: Tesla margin 2023
items.body: Real cause was price cuts. No price data in filings. Answered Low 0.34.

items.heading: Apple revenue FY2023
items.body: Real cause was Mac, iPad and a strong dollar. No segment or FX data. Medium 0.66.

items.heading: Intel revenue 2023
items.body: Real cause was weak PC and server demand. Only pricing pressure was supported.

slides.notes: All three misses are company revenue or price questions where SEC companyfacts has no segment, unit or price data. Committed as-is in examples/eval. Fix: XBRL segment frames and an FX series.
